marketing_description: The DeWALT® DCF513EB 20 V cordless ratchet delivers up to 70 ft-lb of torque and a variable speed trigger with a no-load speed of 250 RPM for fastening and removing tough bolts. Its 3/8 in open head drive and long neck design allow efficient access in tight spaces, while the glass-filled nylon housing provides durability against harsh chemicals and solvents. Trade professionals benefit from a forward/reverse switch and a trigger lock to prevent unintentional activation during demanding applications.
